Sudha Assistant ProfessorM.Sc (Software Systems, Bharathiar University), Ph.D. (Bharathiar University), NET Qualified Link Mrs. V. Sudha is an academic professional with a Ph.D. in Computer Science and NET qualification. She has a strong background in software systems, programming and research, and has contributed significantly to academia through teaching, research publications and participation in national and international conferences. Her research focuses on image processing, machine learning and remote sensing, with several published papers in reputed journals. She has a strong teaching background, having worked in higher education institutions for over ten years and has actively taken on leadership roles in academic and extracurricular activities.
